brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a raid on al-Maghayer and fired tear gas toward residents, Shehab Wire reported. The operation targeted the Palestinian community in the village as troops moved through the area.

The raid is part of ongoing military operations in Palestinian territories. No immediate reports detailed the scale of the incursion, number of personnel involved, or whether there were injuries among residents exposed to the gas.

title: Israeli forces raid al-Maghayer, deploy tear gas at civilians
